subject: Dedicated capacity request: custom GPU matrix + burst overage concession — NeuroForge
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@neuroforge.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity request: custom GPU matrix + urgent burst ask

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Our infra team did a deep pass on expected sustained throughput for the next 6 months and we have a few time-sensitive asks before we commit to a 12-month Dedicated contract. Summary: 1) need a mixed GPU pool (H100s for inference-critical shards + A100s for training-like offline batches) with pinning to instance groups, 2) a guaranteed burst window (up to 2x baseline) for the first 90 days during our ramp, and 3) a one-time overage rollback / temporary overage cap for the first invoice cycle while we stabilize traffic shaping.

We attached a short requirements doc (NeuroForge_capacity_requirements_v1.pdf) — it includes expected token rates per endpoint and a proposed ramp schedule. Our ask: can Redwood provision a custom GPU matrix and provide an exec-level concession on overage treatment (we'd like any burst-generated overage for Month 1 to be waived or credited back).

We're on a short timeline (product launch mid-June) so any temporary carve-outs that allow us to secure capacity today would move the procurement forward. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Infrastructure | NeuroForge
agomez@neuroforge.ai
+1 415-555-0183

Attachment: NeuroForge_capacity_requirements_v1.pdf
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@neuroforge.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request: custom GPU matrix + urgent burst ask

Alicia —

Appreciate the detail and the fast turnaround. Looping in Laura (AE) and Karthik (Sales Lead) to get sizing/price modeling and surface what concessions we can offer. High-level responses:

- Custom GPU matrix (H100 + A100 split) is something our Dedicated team can support; we need to confirm slot counts and pool topology with infra.
- Burst window for ramp: we can provision a temporary burst policy but it will require a reservation hold and a short-term priority mapping; that is a capacity action that needs signoff from Deal Desk / Execs for any overage tolerances.
- Overage rollback/credit: we can consider a one-time credit but it requires a compensating commitment (term length, minimum monthly commit) and legal addendum.

I'll get a draft pricing + concession scenario by EOD and request exec signoff if the ask is outside standard policy. Can you confirm the absolute maximum sustained TPS/token rate during the first 30 days (peak and 95th percentile) so we can model burst costs accurately?

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request: custom GPU matrix + urgent burst ask

Team —

I modeled three concession scenarios quickly:

1) Conservative: Standard pricing, provide burst policy for 30 days with overage billed at standard rate (no credits).
2) Mid: 10% discount on committed units first 6 months + 50% credit on any overage in Month 1 (cap $25k) if NeuroForge signs a 12-month reserved contract.
3) Aggressive (requires exec): Full credit for Month 1 overage up to $75k + temporary H100 burst priority for 90 days. In exchange, NeuroForge agrees to a 12-month commit and an SLA addendum for higher-availability tiers.

I think the Mid plan is saleable, but Alicia is explicitly asking for stronger protections during ramp — we should escalate the Aggressive option for exec signoff. Laura, can you confirm whether NeuroForge has flexibility on commit and whether procurement will accept an SLA addendum? Lauren, please advise on risk tolerance / precedent for Month 1 full-credit concessions.

-Karthik

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request: custom GPU matrix + urgent burst ask

Karthik / team —

Precedent & risk: We have approved limited Month 1 credits in the past for high-growth customers when paired with a firm reserved commit and clear fair-use language. Key guardrails I recommend:

- Credit ceiling (we should not exceed $75k without C-level signoff).
- Timeboxed burst policy (90 days max) with automatic downgrade to standard priority after the period.
- Require NeuroForge to sign the SLA addendum and the revised reserved capacity SOW before provisioning burst priority.
- Add an automatic monitoring/alerting clause so we can throttle if traffic is consistently above modeled ramp.

If we pursue the Aggressive scenario, this needs an Exec email signoff with the specific numbers called out. I can draft the addendum language and the fair-use clause once the numbers are fixed.

— Lauren (Deal Desk)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request: custom GPU matrix + urgent burst ask — Exec decision

Team / JonAS —

Reviewed the ask and the risk controls Lauren proposed. Exec decision: approve the Aggressive concession under these conditions only:

- One-time credit: full credit for Month 1 overage up to $60,000 (not $75k).
- Temporary burst priority: H100 burst priority for up to 90 days, subject to live monitoring and a reservation hold that can be scaled back if sustained usage exceeds the modeled ramp by >30% over a rolling 7-day window.
- Discount: 10% on committed units for first 6 months.
- Contractual requirements: NeuroForge must sign a 12-month reserved capacity commitment (minimum MRC to be finalized by Laura) and execute the SLA_addendum_v2.pdf and the MA plan spreadsheet (NeuroForge_MA_plan.xlsx) prior to provisioning.
- Accounting: Any credit applied will be processed as a billing credit in the month following the observed overage. Finance to confirm impact to revenue recognition.

Lauren — please draft the signoff email and updated addendum. Laura — send the draft MRC and the DocuSign link; do not provision H100 priority until we have the signed addendum and Reservation Hold in the system.

Aditya Rao
VP Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
